command: env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$AGENT_PATH" USER="${USER:-}" LOGNAME="${LOGNAME:-${USER:-}}" TERM="${TERM:-dumb}" LANG="${LANG:-en_US.UTF-8}" CODEX_HOME="$RUN_HOME" codex exec --model gpt-6.1-sol -c model_reasoning_effort="medium" -c web_search="disabled" -c features.apps=false -c features.shell_snapshot=false -c allow_login_shell=false --sandbox workspace-write --json -C "$WS" "$(cat "$FOLDER/prompt.md")" > "$FOLDER/logs/codex-events.jsonl" 2> "$FOLDER/logs/stderr.txt"
